fields.salutation: To poultry producers in Tamarack County and the control area
fields.subject: Control area in effect: what you can and cannot move
body: A highly pathogenic avian influenza detection has been confirmed on a commercial premises in the county. A control area is now in effect, reaching at least 10 km from the infected premises.
You may keep operating. Movement of birds, eggs, litter and equipment off your premises needs a permit, and permits are decided within one business day.
Premises outside the control area but inside the surveillance zone will be contacted for sampling.
actions: Call the permit desk before moving anything.
Keep a log of every vehicle entering your premises.
Report sick or dead birds the same day.
